label: HRRR
source: NOAA HRRR v4 (AWS open data, noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds)

asnow.method: ASNOW, the HRRR's own snowfall (variable snow density)

afzra.method: FRZR, the model's accumulated freezing rain (liquid equivalent, not ice accretion)

aip.method: APCP accumulated in hours whose precipitation type is sleet (priority FZRA > IP > SN > RA; liquid equivalent)

afram.method: radial ice accretion on power lines and branches from the Freezing Rain Accumulation Model (Sanders and Barjenbruch 2016): each hour's ice-to-liquid ratio from the freezing-rain rate, the 2 m wet-bulb temperature and the 10 m wind, times the model's freezing-rain liquid (FRZR), x 0.394 for radial ice

acobb.method: snowfall = column snow-to-liquid ratio x the snow-phase liquid (APCP where the surface type is snow, half where it is a rain-snow mix). Ratio: Cobb and Waldstreicher (2005), in the form of the NBM v4.1 Cobb method (one of the NBM's four snow-ratio methods) - layers saturated with respect to ice every 25 hPa from 925 to 300 hPa, weighted by upward motion and humidity, the 2011 temperature table, limited to 3-30; no melting or compaction

as10.method: 10 x the snow-phase liquid (APCP where the surface type is snow, half where it is a rain-snow mix)

asnod.method: the sum of the hourly INCREASES of the model's snow depth (SNOD); melting and settling are not subtracted

2026102606.method: SHARPlib (Peters et al. 2023 entraining CAPE) on every column of the HRRR's native hybrid levels (wrfnat, lowest 42 levels), the same routine the sounding explorer runs

snd.note: 12 km columns of the 3 km HRRR (every 4th point); level 0 = surface (2 m T/Td, 10 m wind)

2026102600.method: SHARPlib (Peters et al. 2023 entraining CAPE) on every column of the HRRR's native hybrid levels (wrfnat, lowest 42 levels), the same routine the sounding explorer runs

snd.note: 12 km columns of the 3 km HRRR (every 4th point); level 0 = surface (2 m T/Td, 10 m wind)
